children: IES Holdings' revenue rose 32.8% and earnings attributable to the company increased year over year, as strength in Communications, Commercial & Industrial and Infrastructure Solutions more than offset Residential's decline. Higher gross profit margins and a $76.6 million net gain on marketable securities also contributed to results.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to IES Holdings, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Revenue increased 48.0%, driven primarily by strong demand in data centers, distribution centers and high-tech manufacturing; gross margin rose to 25.2%.
: Revenue grew 83.0% on data center demand, Midwest expansion and larger projects; gross margin increased to 28.8%.
: Revenue increased 65.7%, led by custom-engineered solutions and expanded capacity; Gulf Island contributed $150.8 million.
: Revenue declined 6.8% amid weaker housing demand and elevated mortgage rates; gross margin fell to 21.3%.
: Total backlog reached $4,957.9 million at September 30, 2026, up from $2,373.8 million a year earlier, primarily on data center demand.
